Class BmuController

java.lang.Object
com.hospital.admissions.controller.BmuController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/v1/bmu") public class BmuController extends Object
REST controller for Bed Management Unit (BMU) operations.

Exposes endpoints for prioritized admission queues, bed recommendation scoring, bed allocation and override management, ward inventory forecasting, algorithm parameter tuning, sister hospital diversion workflows, batch holding ward conversions, and cohort swap approvals.
